Method of Attack: Local file disclosure vulnerability caused by improper input sanitization allowing attackers to determine and access files on TRS systems via web interface
Extraction of passwords from source code files to escalate privileges or conduct social engineering attacks
Impacted Systems: TRS systems developed by Soleo Communications
TRS systems running on ISPs infrastructure including Rogers, Telus, BCE, Bell, Sasktel, Shaw, Videotron, MTS, Bell Aliant, Cogeco, Fido, Koodo, Chatr, AllStream, EastLink
Attack Vector: Exploitation of local file disclosure vulnerability via web interface
Use of Google dorks to discover vulnerable TRS systems
Indicators of Compromise: iprelayservice.net (host for services of Rogers, Fido, Koodo, Chatr)
Presence of source code files containing passwords on TRS systems
